topic.title: Settings and your account
topic.shortdesc: Install and update the app, change your password, turn on two-factor sign-in, and see and sign out the devices you are signed in on.

body.p: App shows whether the app is installed, how to install it on this device, and the version with Check for updates. See Install the app. Manage accounts goes to Accounts; Sign out signs out this device only.
For push notifications, use Notification settings, which also names the device and sets what it gets.

Voice chooses the voice this device speaks with. Converse sets how Converse behaves on this device: Listen for a follow-up after each answer, and whether the orb shows the live trace (Show). Set these before setting off; they aren't in Converse itself.
Enter the Current password and the new one twice (at least 10 characters), and choose Change password. Every other device is signed out.

ol.li: Scan the QR code with an authenticator app (1Password, Google Authenticator, Authy…). On the phone itself, choose Open in your authenticator app or type in the key.
Enter the Code it shows and choose Turn on.
Save the recovery codes somewhere safe. Each signs you in once if you lose your phone, and they are not shown again.

body.p: To turn it off, enter your Password and choose Turn off two-factor.
Every browser and app signed in to your account, with its IP address and when it was last active. Sign out on any other device ends its session; Sign out all other devices ends them all.
